kitDescription: Sin: Swift Bunny is a Water sniper-rifle Attacker who permanently gains 15.35% ATK and, on every full-charge shot fired with her normal rifle, doubles that shot's normal-attack multiplier and adds 52.12% charge damage for one round. She fights in one of two Bunny Modes: she starts in Stance, which gives her a large permanent crit rate and crit damage package, and can switch to Engage (by holding a full charge for a second) which instead turns her normal attacks into true damage. Her Burst III raises her own ATK by 110% for 5 seconds, hits all enemies for 516.6% of ATK, and adds a second hit that depends on mode: 958.9% in Stance or 854.6% true damage in Engage. Using the burst also swaps her rifle for 5 seconds into Swift Piercing, a 0.5-second fixed-charge weapon dealing 73.22% per shot at a 300% full-charge multiplier, during which her normal-rifle charge buffs do not activate. If she entered a mode, any ally that carries Bunny Modes is pulled into the same mode.

redAssertions: VERBATIM file: every event-reading assertion (S1-a apply, S1-b durationShots/gate count, S2 crit applies + rider ratios, burst atkPct-110 count, burst bucket/fbMajor) sees 0 events because the blind fixture sets onEvent on the CompOptions top level while runComp reads cfg.onEvent — a harness-wiring RECON_ERROR, not a model divergence. With only that one line rerouted, a mental trace of all 20 live assertions against the driver's shipped override finds no failing assertion (driver-reported adapted run: 20 passed / 0 failed / 5 self-declared skips). Two event-shape dependencies of the blind file (an amount-like numeric field and a `bucket` field on damage events) could not be inspected by this judge and are listed as an owner spot-check.

gotchas.summary: Per-pull round convention (theme 21) shifts the 'during Full Charge … for 1 round' pair one round late: the fight's very first charged shot and the first base shot after each Swift Piercing window fire unbuffed (69.04 / charge 2.5), while the first Swift Piercing shot of each window inherits the last base grant (146.44 / charge 3.5212) despite the 'if not in Swift Piercing' clause.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Activates during Full Charge if this unit is not in the Swift Piercing state … for 1 round(s)'. Driver test 'documented boundary residue' pins firstSp.atkPct = 146.44 and firstBack.atkPct = 69.04 per cast; driver caveat 3 documents the swap boundaries + recipe but does not name the fight-opening shot. S2b reviewer 2 flagged the carry-over as 'kit-plausible, leave as documented ⚑'; S6 flag 4 raised the same-shot-vs-next-shot ordering as unresolved by the prose. §11 confirms rounds are spent 'right after the shot so the Nth shot still benefits' — the grant-then-spend order is the engine convention.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Keep the settled convention (no same-shot primitive invented). Extend caveat 3 to name the opening shot. Measurement recipe: in a focus recording compare the first two base-rifle full-charge popups of the fight (equal → the kit buffs the charged shot itself and a same-shot grant primitive is warranted; first ≈ 0.41× second → the convention is right). Net effect is about ±1 shot-equivalent per burst cycle plus one opening shot; do not tune a value to compensate.

gotchas.summary: Swift Piercing shot economy is kit-silent beyond the 0.5s fixed charge: the shipped 9 shots per window rest on (a) the engine's swap-state exemption from the 22f bolt cycle (30f spacing, no release latency) and (b) a magazine refill to her current max ammo; the driver documents (b) but not (a).
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Charge Time: Fixed at 0.5 sec … Duration: 5 sec' — no round count, no magazine, no release animation stated. §4: 'Weapon-swap states … are exempt' from the bolt cycle (engine convention; measured on other units). Driver note 3: '30 frames between pulls … 9 shots fit a 5 s window from a 9-round magazine'; driver caveat 4 flags ammo only. S2b reviewer 2 lists swap cadence and ammo as ALWAYS-⚑; S6 guessed maxAmmo 10 (not adopted — correctly, since it is a guess).
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement, not a value: count Swift Piercing shots and inter-shot frame gaps inside one focus-recorded burst window (and watch for an in-window reload). The shot count is the entire swap calibration (shots × 73.22% × 3.0 × ATK). Add the cadence to caveat 4 so the owner knows 30f/shot is an engine convention, not a kit number. Not a prose contradiction — measurement-gated ⚑.

verdictRationale: All 15 kit lines are FAITHFUL (11) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (4: the mode toggle and the two ally-sync lines, plus the static-mode machinery itself); no SILENT_DROP, no ENGINE routing error, no ENCODING error. The two blind re-derivations converged mechanically: the S6 override is block-equivalent to the driver's (differences are trigger spelling, stage:3, mode label text, and a kit-silent maxAmmo guess the driver rightly left as ⚑), and the S5 blind test traces GREEN against the shipped override once its one harness-wiring defect (onEvent placed outside cfg) is corrected — that red is a RECON_ERROR, not a model divergence. Every load-bearing assertion has a named counterfactual that flips it (swapGate removal, mode-blind riders, trueNormalsModes removal, fullBurstEnter swap, reordered ATK buff, 1.0s swap charge), so discrimination holds. The two gotchas are low and measurement-gated, not board-moving: the theme-21 one-round phase offset (documented at the swap boundaries, unnamed for the opening shot) and the kit-silent Swift Piercing cadence/magazine (ammo documented, the 30f no-bolt cadence not). Nothing must change for GO; extending caveats 3 and 4 is housekeeping. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: (1) the S5 file's reliance on `bucket` and an amount-like field on damage events — I could not inspect the event shape and relied on the trace plus the driver's adapted-run report; (2) the default-mode reading — under full auto the ≥1s hold never occurs, so Stance-all-fight is the auto-play truth and 'Engage' models a deliberate manual toggle; the S6 '≈50/50' uptime claim is speculation, not a correction; (3) no damage-side pin that the Stance crit package reaches `mult` (both tests pin the buffApply only); (4) Pierce is absent from this prose — if the live in-game text carries an 'Additional Effect: Pierce' line on Swift Piercing, the faithful fix is weaponSwap.hasPierce (swap-scoped), never the whole-fight flag; (5) hygiene: unmodeled.skill2 lists the 'Noise Bullets'/'Enhanced Bullets' wrapper sentences whose effects ARE modeled — the note says so, but a census tool reading unmodeled verbatim may miscount them.
